scenes.script: Twelve months. Same market? Not even close. Here's July 2025, versus July 2026.
scenes.headline:
ONE YEAR.
TWO
MARKETS.

scenes.script: Start with stocks. The S&P 500: sixty-two eighty then. Seventy-four eighty-three now — up nineteen percent, and the Dow just closed at a record.
scenes.label: STOCKS · YOY
scenes.headline:
STILL
CLIMBING.

scenes.script: Now, the other side. Bitcoin was around one hundred and eight thousand dollars a year ago. Today: sixty-three thousand. Down forty-two percent — after touching one twenty-six in October.
scenes.label: BITCOIN · YOY
scenes.headline:
CUT NEARLY
IN HALF.

scenes.script: And here's the twist. Inflation was two point seven. Now it's four point two — even after the Fed cut rates. That math is exactly why rate-hike talk is back.
scenes.label: THE TWIST
scenes.headline:
INFLATION
IS BACK.

scenes.script: Oh — and the man in charge? Powell out. Warsh in.
scenes.headline:
POWELL OUT.
WARSH IN.

scenes.script: Same market. Very different year. That's your year over year.
scenes.headline:
SAME MARKET.
DIFFERENT
YEAR.
